about: One entry per value of the core that is pinned to retail Firefox (or Windows). See docs/retail-captures.md.

statuses.generated: a script regenerates the table from the captures named in `sources`; the committed bytes are what it writes
statuses.by-hand: typed in the code; `measurement` names the capture file that bears on it (or says it is missing); `host_needed` names the host a new capture needs
statuses.none-page: no page can read it; `produced_today` says how it is produced
statuses.pending: no entry is pending: every table of _fpforge is generated, by-hand or none-page

entries.what: Baseline WebGL1/2 extension lists (27 and 16 names), used when no persona is applied

measurement.covers: the lists of one Intel integrated GPU on retail 159: 31 and 19 names
measurement.differs: WebGL1: the capture has 4 more (EXT_clip_control, EXT_depth_clamp, EXT_polygon_offset_clamp, EXT_texture_mirror_clamp_to_edge) and the table has none the capture lacks. WebGL2: the capture has 5 more (those four and EXT_texture_norm16) and the table has 2 the capture lacks (EXT_color_buffer_half_float, OES_texture_half_float_linear). The order differs too. The table was measured on 151 and is not changed

entries.host_needed: Windows 11 + GPU (the extension set depends on the ANGLE driver)

entries.what: WebGL numeric answers per GPU model: 41 int params, 3 int2 params, 1 float param, 12 shader-precision triples (3 distinct sets over 14 Windows personas)

measurement.covers: the 57 numbers of one Intel integrated GPU on retail 159, and MAX_VIEWS_OVR 4 (the extension parameter of OVR_multiview2)
measurement.differs: the pool holds 3 sets and the capture, one GPU, decides one of them. Set of the 6 Intel HD personas (slots 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8): identical to the capture, every one of the 57 numbers. Set of the 7 GeForce GTX 980 personas (slots 0, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13): 3 numbers differ from the capture, as expected of another GPU: MAX_VERTEX_UNIFORM_VECTORS 4095 (capture 4096), MAX_VERTEX_UNIFORM_COMPONENTS 16380 (16384), MAX_COMBINED_VERTEX_UNIFORM_COMPONENTS 212988 (212992). Set of the Intel HD Graphics 400 persona (slot 2): MAX_SAMPLES 16 (capture 8). The table is not changed

entries.what: WebGL renderer and vendor strings: 14 pool entries (ANGLE ... or similar) and the 444-row pool of sanitized renderer strings

The pool entries and their weights are an offline extract of third-party telemetry (a fingerprint-network archive for the 444 rows), a population no page capture of one machine can give

The 159 capture carries none of the 14 values as a number (its media queries and computed styles do not give the scrollbar size, the drag distance, the text scale or the double-click selection); three of the 14 (drag threshold, click in a scrollbar track, word selection) need real pointer input, which a capture page cannot produce

entries.what: System colour palette, 46 light and 11 dark ui.* prefs

measurement.covers: the colours a page resolves for the CSS system keywords on retail 159 in one scheme (light): 42 of the 46 light prefs have a keyword
measurement.differs: the table holds the ui.* pref values the engine reads, the capture the colour a page resolves for the keyword, and 21 of the 42 comparable ones differ: ui.activeborder #B4B4B4 (ActiveBorder rgb(129, 127, 132)), ui.activecaption #99B4D1 (rgb(255, 255, 255)), ui.appworkspace #ABABAB (rgb(255, 255, 255)), ui.background #000000 (rgb(255, 255, 255)), ui.buttonface #F0F0F0 (rgb(233, 233, 237)), ui.buttonhighlight #FFFFFF (rgb(233, 233, 237)), ui.buttonshadow #A0A0A0 (rgb(233, 233, 237)), ui.buttonborder #000000 (rgb(129, 127, 132)), ui.inactiveborder #F4F7FC (rgb(129, 127, 132)), ui.inactivecaption #BFCDDB (rgb(255, 255, 255)), ui.inactivecaptiontext #434E54 (rgb(109, 109, 109)), ui.infobackground #FFFFE1 (rgb(255, 255, 255)), ui.menu #F9F9FB (rgb(255, 255, 255)), ui.scrollbar #C8C8C8 (rgb(255, 255, 255)), ui.threeddarkshadow #696969 (rgb(129, 127, 132)), ui.threedface #F0F0F0 (rgb(233, 233, 237)), ui.threedhighlight #FFFFFF (rgb(129, 127, 132)), ui.threedlightshadow #E3E3E3 (rgb(129, 127, 132)), ui.threedshadow #A0A0A0 (rgb(129, 127, 132)), ui.windowframe #646464 (rgb(129, 127, 132)), ui.-moz-hyperlinktext #0066CC (LinkText rgb(0, 0, 238)). The other 21 are equal. Four prefs (ui.-moz_cellhighlighttext, ui.-moz_menubarhovertext, ui.-moz_menuhover, ui.-moz_menuhovertext) have no keyword a page can resolve, and the 11 dark values need a capture with a dark colour scheme. The table is not changed
